entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A metallic plane being invaded by Phyrexia, whose lands change as Phyrexian influence spreads.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The invading force whose assault on Mirrodin intensifies in this set.

entities.name: Karn
